title: Drive the system Chrome over a DevTools pipe
chose: Thesium's own Chrome DevTools Protocol client over --remote-debugging-pipe

over.name: Playwright
over.why: It brings its own dependency tree and its own browser download.

over.name: A headless screenshot command line
over.why: It cannot give Thesium the fonts, the blocked network and the per-slot contexts the web engine needs.

because: The web engine must block every request outside the loopback server. It keeps one context per parallel slot. A pipe needs no WebSocket library.
tradeoff: Thesium maintains its own protocol client and has to cope with Chrome's changing output.
